info.name: Gazebo - Planning Excel Compare
info.description:
Upload a Gazebo **day planning** workbook and compare Excel RM kg to an exploded **draft** plan.

Does **not** lock, publish, or allocate. Reuses the draft plan for that `plan_date` + `location_id` if one exists.

Each successful compare is stored in temp table `excel_compare_report_temp` (drop after sign-off).

**Sheets read:** `PACKING PLAN` (col B code, col M cases) and any sheet whose name contains `Fresh Products` (col B purchase code, col F kg).

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{location_id}}`, `{{report_id}}`.

request.description:
### Compare Excel plan

`POST /planning/excel-compare/`

Uploads a day-planning workbook, maps packing SKUs to catalogue products (`recipe_code` / `alternate_recipe_code` / `gff_code` / `docs/planning-compare/code-map.json`), explodes a **draft** plan, and returns Excel kg vs system kg. Example: grab-and-go 19 Aug file with 5000 cases of `CVSAL-G12T`. The JSON body is also saved to `excel_compare_report_temp` for later GET.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | yes | `.xlsx` or `.xlsm` day plan |
| `location_id` | yes | Location PK to hang the draft plan on |
| `plan_date` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `qty_mode` | no | `cases` (default: packing col M, matches Excel RM kg) or `packs` (trays / cases×trays per case) |
| `dry_run` | no | `true` = parse + map only, no plan/explode |
| `plan_id` | no | Reuse this draft plan instead of date/location lookup |

**Response body**

`status: success`. Message: `Excel plan exploded and compared.` (or dry-run variant).

`data.report_id` (temp row PK), `data.plan_id`, `data.run_id`, `data.finished_goods[]` (`excel_code`, `cases`, `product_id`, `match`), `data.rm_compare[]` (`excel_kg`, `system_kg`, `diff_kg`, `diff_pct`, `fix`), `data.system_only[]`, `data.unmapped_fg[]`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Dry run parsed |
| 201 | Draft exploded and compared |
| 400 | Missing file/fields, unknown location, unmapped FG, bad workbook |
| 409 | Plan exists for that date/location and is not draft |
| 422 | Explode business error |

### Compare Excel plan (dry run)

`POST /planning/excel-compare/`

Same upload as Compare Excel plan, with `dry_run=true`. Maps FG/RM codes and returns `finished_goods` / `rm_compare` **without** creating a plan or exploding. Use this to confirm mappings (`match: code|map|name|unmapped`) before a live explode. Still writes a temp report (`data.report_id`).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

Same multipart fields as Compare Excel plan. `dry_run` must be `true`.

**Response body**

`200` `Excel plan compared (dry run).` `data.report_id` is set. `data.plan_id` and `data.run_id` are null. `data.system_kg` on RM rows is null.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Parsed |
| 400 | Missing file/fields or bad workbook |

### List Excel compare reports

`GET /planning/excel-compare/`

Returns the latest 50 temp compare dumps from `excel_compare_report_temp` (newest first). Use this during testing instead of keeping the POST body. Drop the table after sign-off.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | no | Filter to one location PK |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`200` `Excel compare reports listed.` `data.count` is the unfiltered-by-limit total. `data.items[]` has `id`, `created_at`, `location_id`, `plan_date`, `dry_run`, `file_name`, `plan_id`, `run_id` — not the full JSON payload.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Listed |
| 400 | `location_id` is not an integer |

### Get Excel compare report

`GET /planning/excel-compare/:report_id/`

Returns one temp dump including the original compare JSON in `payload`. Example: after a dry run of the 19 Aug grab-and-go file, fetch `report_id` from the POST body.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report_id` | yes | Temp report PK from POST `data.report_id` |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`200` `Excel compare report retrieved.` Summary fields plus `payload` (same shape as POST `data` without `report_id`).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Found |
| 404 | Unknown `report_id` |
